acceptance_evidence.evidence: Cargo metadata resolved Rust 1.93.1 and exactly one coop-protocol workspace member; rust-toolchain.toml pins 1.93.1.
Explicit RegionId ordinals, wire conversions, and region serialization are implemented and tested.
Typed region-qualified identities enforce canonical uppercase keys and reject malformed, unknown-region, and cross-kind values.
WorldLocation, WorldZone, RegionalProgress, TravelRoute, and Compatibility use fixed-width fields, validation, normalized collections, and deterministic JSON serialization.
Regional tier tests prove the Hoenn/Kanto example, ignore other-region badges, and fail closed on missing regional progress.
Group and atomic travel tests prove symmetric membership, denial without source-zone mutation, and successful all-entitled transfer.
Metadata, focused tests, formatting, clippy with warnings denied, workspace tests, and git diff checks passed.
